Added in working tree, compared to 049665fc106.
final class Generations
Restricted visibility: declared "@visibility SqlSemantics\Platform\MySql". Code outside that scope must not name this declaration.

Refuses repeated node occurrences and contradictory language requirements.

Rule: MYSQL-QUERY-GENERATIONS-001. PROCEDURE ANALYSE, SQL_CACHE and the legacy trailing-clause forms end before 8.0. WITH, VALUES, TABLE, window specifications, JSON_TABLE, QUALIFY, INTERSECT and EXCEPT start in 8.x or later. A graph containing both sets cannot belong to any supported release. This includes legacy password calls, WEIGHT_STRING levels, table escapes and generated-column entry points nested inside modern statements. Every MySQL statement constructor and composite expression checks its entire graph. This is a constructor invariant; it does not decide whether a statement executes or whether a particular release accepts every feature. Source: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/mysql-nutshell.html, https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/with.html, https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/set-operations.html. Status: Implemented.
